summary.note: operates on the caller's own principal, a service credential, or is public: no tenant identifier to cross

explained.scimServiceProviderConfig: static discovery document, identical for every organization
explained.scimListUsers: a list scoped to the TOKEN's organization: B sees B's users only (asserted: 0 of A's)
explained.scimCreateUser: creates in the TOKEN's own organization (no tenant identifier in the request); 4xx validation is also fine, 5xx is not
explained.scimListGroups: role groups of the token's organization (asserted: no A member appears)
